title: Learning to Reason and Use Tools through Unsupervised Fine-Tuning in Task-Oriented Dialog Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.30426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current dialogue systems struggle with dynamic information retrieval, often leading to hallucinations and lower response accuracy. We address this by adapting the ReAct framework for Task-Oriented Dialogue, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to access external knowledge and produce factual responses. Mainly, we propose an unsupervised fine-tuning pipeline that harvests reasoning trajectories via in-context learning inference. High-quality samples are filtered using an LLM-based judge to construct a robust training set. This is enhanced by a unsupervised self-improvement loop, where improved checkpoints generate increasingly better trajectories for subsequent fine-tuning iterations. Experiments on the SIMMC dataset demonstrate that ReAct-based systems outperform baselines due to superior reasoning and tool use. Notably, our fine-tuned 8B model surpasses a 70B in-context system. translated_title: 通过无监督微调在任务导向对话系统中学习推理与工具使用
translated_abstract: 当前对话系统在动态信息检索方面存在困难，常常导致幻觉现象和较低的响应准确性。我们通过将ReAct框架适配到任务导向对话中来解决这一问题，使大语言模型（LLM）能够访问外部知识并生成符合事实的响应。主要地，我们提出了一种无监督微调流水线，通过上下文学习推理来收集推理轨迹，并使用基于LLM的评判器过滤高质量样本以构建鲁棒的训练集。这进一步通过一个无监督自我改进循环得到增强，其中性能提升后的检查点会为后续的微调迭代生成越来越好的轨迹。在SIMMC数据集上的实验表明，基于ReAct的系统凭借出色的推理和工具使用能力优于基线方法。值得注意的是，我们微调后的8B模型超越了70B的上下文学习系统。最后，我们展示了错误分析以及场景组合的影响。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无监督微调流水线，将ReAct框架应用于任务导向对话系统，通过LLM评判器筛选高质量推理轨迹并借助自我改进循环不断优化，使微调后的8B模型超越了70B的上下文学习系统。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an unsupervised fine-tuning pipeline that adapts the ReAct framework for task-oriented dialogue, filtering high-quality reasoning trajectories with an LLM-based judge and leveraging a self-improvement loop, enabling a fine-tuned 8B model to surpass a 70B in-context system.
